warnings: This house's wall-plate ('อะเส') level and everything above it (roof frame, S-07/S-08) switches from the RC frame (footings/pedestals/floor beams, columns marked C1) to a light-gauge STEEL post-and-ring-beam system (CS1 posts, BS1 ring beam), a hybrid RC-below/steel-above structure. This contradicts the column schedule on S-15, which shows an up-arrow ('continues unchanged') at the 'ระดับอะเส' row for column C1 — that generic table convention appears not to account for the material switch documented here; not resolved by inventing RC rebar for C1 at this level, flagged instead.

Each of the 4 interior bays (A-B/B-C x 1-2/2-3) shows a dashed diagonal X between the CS1 posts, with a small 'x' mark at the crossing point and no printed member mark, size, or leader text anywhere on the sheet. Interpreted as probable diagonal wind bracing between the steel posts (consistent with a light post-and-beam system) but NOT recorded as an element — no mark, no dimension, and no confirming spec on any other sheet in this set; recording it would require inventing a member that is undimensioned and unlabeled.
